map.SMA、WMA、EMA 怎么选？: How to choose SMA, WMA, EMA?
map.SMA 最平滑但滞后；WMA 给近期更高权重、对拐点更敏感；EMA 用 α 递推: SMA is smoothest but lags; WMA gives recent higher weight and is more sensitive to turning points; EMA uses α recursively, needs only the previous result, and suits streaming forecasts. Use SMA for noisy data, WMA/EMA for strong trends you want to track closely.
map.窗口 N 越大越好吗？: Is a larger window N always better?
map.N 越大越平滑但越滞后、越忽略近期；N 越小越灵敏但易受噪声干扰。一般取 3–6: Larger N is smoother but lags more and ignores recent data; smaller N is more sensitive but prone to noise. Typically 3-6; for obvious seasonality use the cycle length (e.g. 12).
